newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds set to decline towards 99.70.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds set to decline towards 99.70.

text.p: LIFFE June Bund futures are set to head lower on Monday and will seek to break down through 100.25 and on to 99.70, technical analysts said.

Robin Wilkin, senior technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch in London, said a break of 100.25, a 62 percent Fibonacci retracement of the rally from 99.70 on April 14 to 101.14 on April 17, would confirm that a top was in place at 101.14.
"Daily studies look bearish, we had a strong breakdown on Friday and I am really looking for that to continue over the short term with initial losses to 99.70," he said.
At 0708 GMT, June Bund futures were at 100.45 up 0.01.
In early trade the contract matched Friday's high at 100.54.
Wilkin said Bunds might correct up a little after rebounding from a low at 100.28 on Friday but any upside moves would be limited.

"To the upside there is a range of resistances starting at 100.57 right up to 100.76," he said, adding that these levels marked the 38 and 62 percent Fibonacci retracements of the move down on Thursday and Friday from 101.05 to 100.28.
"If they started getting back through the 100.76, 80 then we would probably see a push back up to retest the 101.00 to 101.14 area, but I'm not looking for it to go that high," he said.
Over the next week or so, Wilkin said Bunds could push down to the lows at the beginning of April around 99.05.
But some chartists were more positive for Bunds.
Technical analysts at Chase in London said the rally on Friday from 100.28 to 100.46 had built an impulsive structure.
"But a break of 100.55 was required to trigger an Elliott wave buy signal suggesting an initial test of trendline resistance at 100.63," they said in a research note.
A minor setback from here is likely, but once Bunds were above 100.55 any setbacks should be used to add to long positions, they said.
"A daily closing price above 100.63 adds to bullish momentum allowing it to move above 101.05/14 resistance area," the Chase analysts said.
At the short end, June Euromarks were at 96.75, unchanged from Friday's close.
